conservation_rules: occupied_capacity must never exceed room capacity
one population_slot_ref cannot occupy multiple current rooms
room assignment never creates or deletes cadet population
rules: Assignment history remains after a cadet moves or departs.
An ended assignment is historical context and is not deleted.
Room inventory must exist before assignment.
Unresolved demand remains explicit instead of synthesizing capacity.
Current occupant slots must resolve to active Academy cadet membership unless an explicit transition is in progress.
